description: A six-armed crystal that never quite melts. Winterfang's mane grows them and drops them behind it.
lore: Never quite is the whole of it. A dropped star loses a hair's width a year and no more, so a trail of them is a trail with dates on it: big ones from this winter, smaller from the winter before, back and back until you are reading a line the animal walked a century ago and can still put your thumb on.

[[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]] measures those lines, because they are the only straight thing this country hands out free. He has one off the north fells, eighty stars long, and the far half of it does not lie where the near half points. The ground under it moved. He wrote the numbers down and has shown them to no one, and when [[monsters/ice_wolf|Winterfang]] comes up at a fire he talks about the cold instead.
gm_notes: Gunnar's eighty-star line is a Drift measurement of soft ground moving toward inhabited country. He is sitting on it. Do not resolve what he has concluded.
